sermon.title: The Holy Spirit’s Support of Jesus 12/17/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the Holy Spirit always testifies of Jesus and the scriptures, never of himself or other religious figures. He contrasts natural and spiritual understanding, tests other “spirits” by whether they confess Christ, defines the spirit of antichrist from 1 John 4, and closes with John 14:23: those who love Jesus can have the Father, Son and Holy Spirit dwelling in them.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Names of congregants and family are in the transcript only. Kept as spoken: “Hawkins” (likely Stephen Hawking) quote, “something out of nothing” (2:10); garbled terms marked [unclear]. Points to check: Stephen Hawking quote as paraphrased; NASA claim about the earth stopping (7:28); AA “less than 7 percent results” (23:13); “25 percent of Catholics are spirit-filled” (32:40). Sensitive content kept as spoken: evolution claims “as dumb as you can get”; Bill O’Reilly’s priest called the Bible allegory; Jesus-only/Oneness teaching “ridiculous”; Mormon encounter, “your spirit an evil spirit”; Native American and African spirits, Alcoholics Anonymous higher power; Church of Satan encounter; Catholics and Mary; Left Behind antichrist teaching.
